title_en: A Hot Bath: Conserving Water Without Losing Uniformity

assessment_en: Uncalibrated author-external AI opinion: Outstanding-centered, adjacent Finalist–Outstanding. This is not an official award; physical parameters and human motion remain uncalibrated.

strength_en: Separates heat replacement from transport to the coldest region. Under the stated bath conditions, a qualified six-stage schedule uses 21.48 L versus 24.14 L for the best accepted constant trickle; the guide now distinguishes the temperature allowance from the faucet-start decision.
strength_zh: 把补热与热量到达冷端的时间分开。在给定浴缸条件下，合格六段补水为 21.48 L，最佳已接受恒流为 24.14 L；使用指南明确区分温度容差与开水时机。
